title: Wacky Enchantments
description: New, beautiful, tasteful enchantments for you sillyful needs
body:
##

New, silly enchantments

##

What, When, Where

A total of 13 new enchantments have been added, including 2 curses. | Enchantment | Applies To | Description | | -------- | ------- | ------- | | Explodathon | TNT | Explodes TNT instantaneously. | | Bird Man['s] Gust | Elytra | Brings you to a low gravity state for extra height | | _**Curse of Infesting**_ | Pickaxe | May spawn silverish when you break a block. | | Reversal Returtsal | Turtle Shell | Adds Fire Resistance, Levitation, and Slow Falling in certain scenarios. | | Nine Lives | Totem | Gives you an extra totem use per level. | | **_Curse of Blinding_** | Head Armor | Blinds you. | | Randomizer | Boots | Randomizes the block below you. | | Garbage Collector | Shovel | Gets trash out of the floor. | | Yummers | Trident | Fills hunger occasionally when hitting entities. | | Extinguish | Flint & Steel | Does not set fire, and sometimes, set the opposite! | | Immobilizing | Hoe | Freezes Players | | Container Locainor | Compass | Points to the nearest container. | | Pounding | Mace | Throws blocks into the air when a mob is hit. | Also adds a new structure: the Abandoned Library! After this, I will be adding new commands to Minecraft. To suggest one, go into the comments of the [linked video above](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hy5SVfDvaFA). This is inspired by my Enchantment _Datapack_, Cerium.
